content.text: {"deal_state_line":"Open technical gap: nested mhp_roles claim is not supported today (flat claims only), and the October 9th security committee packet needs a written SSO design.","customer_value_line":"Reporting piece fits the stated goal of moving the readmission risk list from weekly to daily so care managers can call the morning after discharge; Nora: \"The whole goal is daily.\"","what_we_validated":["Readmission pipeline runs incrementally on the de-identified extract; last night's run took nine minutes (Sunday job takes most of the day, per Nora).","Output list sorted by risk, filtered by facility, with top three drivers per row; Nora said it is what they have asked for for two years.","Late claims (thirty, forty days) restate the score, with the change logged in a change log on the row.","BAA: customer legal already has the standard BAA; Aisha said that part is fine.","Customer managed keys: Leo said they are on a cloud key service, which fits."],"integration_patterns":["Customer runs its own OIDC layer; group membership comes in a nested custom claim mhp_roles (facility, role, clearance level). Apex maps flat claims only today (string or list of strings), per RC-09; nested claims are in private preview with no announced GA date.","No SCIM; customer provisions with a nightly job writing to the app's API.","Option one: customer emits an extra flat claim; needs a token service change, Raj's review, six to eight weeks minimum.","Facility filter on the list depends on reading facility from the token; otherwise the mapping is maintained by hand.","Customer managed keys on a major cloud key service; on-prem HSMs are not supported per RC-11."],"objections_and_answers":["SSO worry (Aisha): nested mhp_roles vs flat-only mapping. Status: open.","Flat-claim workaround is slow (Leo): token service change goes through Raj, six to eight weeks minimum. No answer given. Status: open.","Care managers losing trust if someone drops off the list overnight (Aisha): change log exists on the row; push notification is a design choice to discuss with Nora's team. Status: partially resolved, parked.","Nothing moves until vendor security review clears (Aisha): committee meets October 9th; complete packet makes that agenda, otherwise November. Status: open."],"open_items":["Marcus: firm answer from identity team on native nested claims, with a date Leo can put in front of Raj (not a roadmap slide).","Marcus: written SSO design for the security committee, needed even if the answer is option one.","Jordan: complete security packet to Aisha, copy Raj, before October 9th (questionnaire, SOC 2, encryption details, SSO design).","Procurement (via Aisha): send the vendor questionnaire to Apex;
